entities.summary: The Sultanate of Banjar was a nation-state of the Banjar in the form of a Islamic sultanate in Borneo which was founded in 1526 and existed until its dissolution in 1860 by the colonial government of the Dutch East Indies and its collapse in 1905. The Banjar Sultanate was restored in the 2010 restoration, but without political power.
